annotations.title: List approved items waiting to be scheduled

description:
[read-only] FFE-2225: the "To schedule" tray: content that was approved but never booked (approvals_bulk_decide with `when` "tray", the default). Tray items never post on their own. Book one with publish (`contentId`, `platforms`, `scheduledAt`), or approve a new batch with `when: { spread }` to book them out on a cadence. Paged: pass `nextCursor` back as `cursor` until it is null; `brandId` narrows to one brand.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/approvals/tray.)

brandId.description: Format: string; e.g. "brandId_123". "personal" or a brand id; a brand-bound key only sees its own brand.

cursor.description: Format: string; e.g. "eyJvIjoyMH0". `nextCursor` from the previous page.

limit.description: Format: integer; e.g. 20. Maximum number of results to return.
